page_title: EVE 2-2 IPS | Everton v Ipswich 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Lewis Smith is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Julio Enciso is replaced by Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich).
90+1' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+1' The ball is out of play and Ipswich manage to earn a corner.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) replaces Idrissa Gueye.
90' Carlos Alcaraz will be replaced by Chermiti (Everton).
86' Jake O'Brien (Everton) is penalised for holding. Lewis Smith signals a set piece.
82' Here is a change. Nathan Patterson is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Ashley Young (Everton).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jack Taylor departs the field of play to be replaced by Jens Cajuste (Ipswich).
81' George Hirst (Ipswich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Lewis Smith didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' Nathan Patterson (Everton) has received a yellow card for his foul.
79' 2 - 2 It's a goal! George Hirst (Ipswich) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:2.
79' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) for a tough tackle.
78' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Dwight McNeil will be replaced by Jack Harrison (Everton).
77' Substitution. Beto walks off the pitch and Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
76' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
75' Nathan Patterson (Everton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
73' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Substitution. George Hirst (Ipswich) replaces Liam Delap.
68' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Clarke (Ipswich) replacing Conor Chaplin.
68' A substitution has been made. Samy Morsy goes off and Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) comes on.
65' The yellow card is received by Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
65' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) is cautioned by the referee.
60' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Palmer intercepts the ball.
59' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Julio Enciso (Ipswich), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
57' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) is able to continue to play.
56' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
55' The game is interrupted now, Julio Enciso (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Foul! Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
51' Beto (Everton) jumps into a tackle and Lewis Smith signals a foul.
48' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Dwight McNeil (Everton) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
41' 2 - 1 Julio Enciso (Ipswich) unleashes a powerful shot from long distance. His precise attempt glances off the bar into the back of the net and leaves the goalkeeper beaten.
39' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
37' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Jordan Pickford rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
35' 2 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Dwight McNeil (Everton) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
33' The yellow card goes to Samy Morsy (Ipswich).
31' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
30' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets a yellow card.
28' Jake O'Brien (Everton) receives a yellow card for infringement.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Beto (Everton) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Carlos Alcaraz and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 1:0.
26' Poor challenge! Julio Enciso (Ipswich) is penalised for tripping and Lewis Smith blows his whistle.
25' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
21' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Julio Enciso (Ipswich) blazes well wide of the right post.
21' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Liam Delap (Ipswich), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
15' Beto (Everton) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
14' Lewis Smith blows his whistle and signals a foul after Liam Delap (Ipswich) brought his opponent down.
12' Beto (Everton) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies high over the bar.
11' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Palmer (Ipswich).
8' Beto (Everton) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
8' The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
4' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Liam Delap (Ipswich) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jordan Pickford easily catches the ball.
2' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Ipswich will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Lewis Smith.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
